about: Raw numbers for eval/bakeoff/REPORT.md. Scores are 0-100; block = score >= T, veto = score <= V. Rates are fractions. "browser" = Chrome for Testing, the extension's real decode, fp16, WASM unless marked.

licences.name: tinyclip-vit-8m-16-yfcc15m
licences.licenceQuote: license: mit (HF card header); card section '## License' links https://github.com/microsoft/Cream/blob/main/TinyCLIP/LICENSE, which begins 'MIT License / Copyright (c) Microsoft Corporation.'
licences.caveats: Trained on YFCC-15M (public Flickr CC-licensed images); no separate weights licence stated anywhere.

licences.name: tinyclip-vit-8m-16-yfcc15m-onnx
licences.licenceQuote: license: mit (HF card header); card links https://github.com/microsoft/Cream/blob/main/TinyCLIP/LICENSE (MIT)
licences.caveats: Converted copy; licence inherited from upstream (verified MIT).

licences.name: tinyclip-resnet-19m-laion400m
licences.licence: MIT for code (Cream); weights file has NO explicit licence statement
licences.licenceQuote: No quote for this weights file. wkcn/TinyCLIP-model-zoo GitHub API license=null, repo has only README.md and figure/, README has no licence text. Cream/TinyCLIP/LICENSE (code) begins 'MIT License'.
licences.caveats: Not rejected on content: the same authors tag their sibling checkpoints (ViT-8M, ViT-40M) MIT on HF and the Cream README points to the MIT LICENSE. But this file has no HF copy and no licence statement of its own, so by the never-guess rule it is rejected pending a coordinator decision. Also needs a custom torch export (ModifiedResNet, open_clip fork) and is .pt only.

licences.name: tinyclip-vit-45m-32-auto-laionyfcc400m
licences.licence: MIT for code (Cream); weights file has NO explicit licence statement
licences.licenceQuote: No quote for this weights file; model-zoo repo has no licence (see ResNet-19M entry).
licences.caveats: Same licence gap as ResNet-19M. Independently over the size cap: ~90 MB fp16, so it could only ever be a reference.

licences.name: tinyclip-vit-40m-32-laion400m
licences.licenceQuote: license: mit (HF card header); card links https://github.com/microsoft/Cream/blob/main/TinyCLIP/LICENSE (MIT)
licences.caveats: Over the 50 MB cap at fp16 (~80 MB), so reference only. Trained on LAION-400M (web-scraped; dataset caveats).

licences.name: dinov2-small
licences.licenceQuote: license: apache-2.0 (HF card header at the pinned sha); dinov2 README: 'DINOv2 code and model weights are released under the Apache License 2.0.'
licences.caveats: The upstream README also lists FAIR Noncommercial Research weights, but only for the separate X-ray DINO and Cell-DINO models, not for DINOv2 ViT-S/14. Trained on LVD-142M (curated web images). Latency risk: ViT-S/14 at 224 is 256 tokens.

licences.name: mobilenetv3-large-100
licences.licenceQuote: license: apache-2.0 (HF card header; datasets: imagenet-1k); pytorch-image-models LICENSE: 'Apache License Version 2.0, January 2004'
licences.caveats: ImageNet-1k caveat: weights are tagged Apache-2.0 but were trained on ImageNet-1k, whose dataset terms are research/non-commercial. Not a rejection; the report must state it.

licences.name: efficientnet-lite0
licences.licenceQuote: license: apache-2.0 (HF card header; datasets: imagenet-1k); pytorch-image-models LICENSE: 'Apache License Version 2.0, January 2004'
licences.caveats: ImageNet-1k caveat as for MobileNetV3. Weights are ported from the Google TF EfficientNet-Lite release (tensorflow/tpu, Apache-2.0); upstream not separately checked.

licences.name: clip-vit-b-32
licences.licence: MIT (code repo); HF model has no licence tag
licences.licenceQuote: openai/CLIP LICENSE: 'MIT License / Copyright (c) 2021 OpenAI'. HF API cardData.license is absent; model card has no licence line and says 'The model is intended as a research output for research communities.'
licences.caveats: HF model repo carries no licence tag or LICENSE file; MIT comes from the code repo only. Card says intended for research. Moot because it is a ceiling reference only and never shipped. Trained on undisclosed web data.

licences.name: mobileclip-s0
licences.licence: apple-amlr (Apple Machine Learning Research Model licence)
licences.licenceQuote: Upstream apple/MobileCLIP-S0 LICENSE: 'This Apple Machine Learning Research Model is specifically developed and released by Apple Inc. ("Apple") for the sole purpose of scientific research of artificial intelligence and machine-learning technology.' ... '"Research Purposes" means non-commercial scientific research'
licences.caveats: Research-only, cannot ship in the store build. Xenova copy is tagged 'license: other' and its LICENSE file is Apple's generic software notice, which does not override the upstream weights licence. Baseline only.
